endorsements.quote: To mitigate this issue, SIIAM should promote educational and informational projects to elevate awareness of the benefits of AI’s application in healthcare in underserved regions.
Therefore, targeted efforts must be made to include elderly individuals in educational initiatives, ensuring they understand and can access AI technologies.

unlisted_practices: Invest significantly in digital infrastructure in remote, low-income areas and for elderly populations to enable practical implementation of AI solutions.
Validate each step performed by AI when using LLMs for literature data extraction and analysis.
Have physicians review and finalize LLM-drafted discharge letters.

screen.reason: This report synthesizes proceedings, views, and proposals from a multi-disciplinary workshop held by the Italian Society for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine rather than evaluating an AI system empirically.
